fields.acceptance_criteria: Current frontend endpoint inventory is documented for ticket-viewer and ticket-vscode; redesign specifies reversible per-item ticket identity for aggregated child-workspace results; request semantics for explicit workspace scope plus include/exclude child workspaces are specified with backward-compatible defaults; migration expectations for ticket-viewer and ticket-vscode are captured
fields.title: [ticket-http] Design: workspace-aware ticket references for child-workspace frontend endpoints
